name: Surrealism Window examples
description: Reproducibly generated demo bundles. Index only — no trust implied.

bundles.name: Demo: append an overlay config blob
bundles.author: surreal demo
bundles.description: Appends 88 bytes after the last section. Overlay growth is the only size change that needs no header, section table or RVA fixups.

bundles.name: Demo: blank the version string
bundles.author: surreal demo
bundles.description: Hides the build string in .rdata. Size-preserving, so it can be combined with other patches in a collection.

bundles.name: Demo: shorten the nag only where it still exists
bundles.author: surreal demo
bundles.description: Same edit as demo-shorten-nag, but it refuses anything that is not a 64-bit image with a .rdata section, and it skips the string hunk when the trial text is not in the build. This is what a .morph can do without any scripting runtime: declarative conditions, no code.

bundles.name: Demo: grow the last section
bundles.author: surreal demo
bundles.description: Appends 60 bytes to the last section and rewrites VirtualSize, SizeOfRawData and SizeOfImage. This is the header-surgery path: still declarative, still verified by a replay during generation.

bundles.name: Demo: blank the trial nag + flip one branch
bundles.author: surreal demo
bundles.description: Generated from surreal.testkit fixtures. Two edits: a conditional jump is inverted and the nag string is blanked in place. Same-length, size-preserving.
